notes.title: Returning to development
notes.notes:
Hi all. Since the release of Super Cube Smash, I have been working tirelessly on my next game, which I will be unavailing soon.

For now, I would like to announce that I have not abandoned Super Cube Smash. I will be back with updates for it soon. I am working on a couch coop 2 player mode, plus other gamemodes.

I will also be adding steam achievements, and possibly traiding cards.

I will not be releasing DLC's for Super Cube Smash. Instead, I will be adding content to the core game free of charge.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Available on steam
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 Is now Live on Steam for Windows and Mac!

A big thank you to all who greenlit my game.

I have done my best with testing, but ultimately I am a team of 1, so I'm pretty sure there will be some errors to fix.

Version 1.1 will be out in a month or 2 with a bunch of fixes if/where needed.

Big Love
